verdict.rationale: Gusto documents an official MCP server (mcp.api.gusto.com) with OAuth2-based connection process supporting Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Gemini CLI, plus a separate Embedded Dev Assistant MCP server for API/docs access from Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Desktop. This is clearly first-party, documented, and covers both data-access and dev-assistant use cases. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.
